About

Hello, I’m Preetham ND.

I’m a full-stack developer working on an enterprise healthcare product: electronic health records, billing, procurement, inventory and the workflow engine that ties them together.

Most of my work is turning detailed business rules into services and screens that behave predictably: clear APIs, careful validation and permissions, and data that stays consistent across modules.

Alongside product work, I build the AI-assisted developer platform my team uses to plan, fix, migrate and test code, with approval gates and read-only access to production data built in.

Engineering profile

What I work on.

Backend engineering

Java, Spring Boot and Spring Security services, REST APIs, JPA and Hibernate, organised as microservices.

Frontend engineering

Angular and React with TypeScript: component-based screens for complex clinical and operational workflows.

Workflow orchestration

Sequential and parallel workflows, approval flows and state transitions for business processes.

Healthcare systems

EHR workflows across OPD, IPD, emergency and daycare, plus the billing, procurement and inventory around them.

AI-assisted development

Claude Code commands, agents and MCP integrations that make engineering work faster without giving up review.

Quality & release

JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine and Karma tests, automated builds, and disciplined, versioned releases.
